specs.v1-like: Baseflow only, trained 2007+ (≈ v1 on the Johnson Ranch series)
specs.A-h12-1950: Baseflow only, 1950+, 12-yr half-life (fair baseline for ENSO)
specs.A-h12-1982: Baseflow only, 1982+, 12-yr half-life (fair baseline for rainfall)
specs.R-h12: Baseflow + Conchos basin rainfall (4-mo anomaly), 1982+, 12-yr half-life
specs.M-h12: Baseflow + 365-day mean flow (wet/dry regime memory), 1936+, 12-yr half-life
specs.AM-h12: Composite: A-h12 to 60 d, blended into M-h12 by 90 d (long-lead memory)

selection.metric: mean forward-chained Brier skill, leads 3/7/14/30/45/60 d, 200-1200 cfs, issued Aug-Nov

longLead.metric: mean forward-chained Brier skill, leads 90/120/150/180 d, 200-1200 cfs, issued Aug-Nov
